title: Devotion — Online Group Exhibition
summary: An online group show on devotion in its tender and darker forms, curated by Polaroid emulsion-lift artist Laura Barth. Analogue work only; the exhibition opens at the end of November.

title: Call for Photographs: Our Bodies that are Unruly
eligibility: Anyone aged 18 or over, based anywhere

rights.summary: Copyright stays with the photographer; Autograph may show selected images to promote the project on its website, social media and in press.

summary: Autograph wants pictures of the body as a place of resistance and self-definition, from new work to old family snaps. Its favourites go into an online gallery; up to three images each, and film scans are welcome.

evidence.deadline: The deadline to apply is 10am, Monday 7 December 2026
evidence.fee: The call for photographs is free to enter
evidence.rights: Copyright for any images you submit will remain with you.

title: Earth Photo 2027
organiser: Earth Photo (Parker Harris, Royal Geographical Society and Forestry England, with Photoworks)
eligibility: Anyone worldwide, for work made in the last five years
summary: An international award for still and moving images about the planet, from climate impacts to restoration. Prizes include cash awards, a residency and a Royal Geographical Society exhibition, plus awards for entrants aged 25 or under.

evidence.fee: Earth Photo is free to enter

title: Walk of Water Photostory Contest: Out of Sight
summary: A photostory contest run with UN water and environment programmes on water and health, with its main prize aimed at the rarely photographed world of wastewater and sanitation.

title: THE DRAFT — Tessa Boffin: Where We Touch the Archive
organiser: Devonshire Collective, Photoworks, BACKLIT and Aspex Portsmouth
eligibility: LGBTQIA+ artists, writers, researchers and activists

rights.summary: Copyright stays with the contributor; the organisers get a non-exclusive licence to reproduce contributions in the publication and related project materials.

summary: A queer publication that grows over a UK touring exhibition about artist Tessa Boffin. Contributors share something that already exists, such as a photograph or contact sheet, along with a question for the next person.

evidence.rights: You retain copyright of your contribution.

title: RPS International Photography Exhibition 168

fee.note: per entry after one free single image; £27 RPS members, £20 under-30s

eligibility: Anyone, of any age or level of practice
summary: The Royal Photographic Society's long-running annual open exhibition. Selected work tours UK venues and is up for cash awards, including one for under-30s; shortlisted entrants send prints for the final round.

evidence.deadline: Entry will close for new entries at 23:59 GMT on Tuesday 15 December 2026
evidence.fee: Subsequent entries are subject to payment: Standard £35, RPS Member £27, Under 30 years old £20.
